about: Lasm test evidence (scripts/evidence/page.mjs). "ci" holds what CI measured, read from the GitHub API at generatedAt; "repository" holds what is recorded in the repository and checked by CI on every change. Rendered as content/learn/test-evidence.md.

platformLevels.L2: Its output matches Node's across the differential tests, and the platform's own conformance suites pass
platformLevels.L3: A full example app also passes an independent test suite, plus fuzzing and simulation

mutationBaseline.tool: Stryker 10.0.0 with the tap runner over node:test (scripts/mutation/run.mjs)

fuzzTargets.name: cli-arguments
fuzzTargets.description: the CLI's argument parser (src/cli-arguments.mjs and the init, dev and package parsers it calls).

fuzzTargets.name: serverless-http
fuzzTargets.description: the function platforms' HTTP boundary (src/serverless/): AWS Lambda's event → request mapping (API Gateway REST and HTTP API, function URLs, ALB, CloudFront) in lasm-lambda.mjs, and the helpers of lasm-server.mjs every platform shim uses (outgoingHeaders, joinCookies, parseSetCookie, azureReply, webReply, isTextual).

fuzzTargets.name: ui-patch
fuzzTargets.description: the Lasm.UI patch decoder (src/lasm-modules/ui-dom.mjs, the browser side of library/Lasm/UI/Encode.lean) against happy-dom.

fuzzTargets.name: ui-decode
fuzzTargets.description: the Lasm.UI patch applier's reading (src/lasm-modules/ui-dom.mjs) against Lean's reference decoder of the same stream (library/Lasm/UI/Proofs/Decode.lean, which Spec.frames_decode proves reads every frame the encoder writes as exactly its patch).

fuzzTargets.name: lasm-js-wire
fuzzTargets.description: the Lasm.JS value codec's JavaScript half (src/node-js.mjs: the Writer and Reader every value between Lean and JavaScript crosses) against Lean's half (Wire in library/Lasm/JS/Core.lean), the code whose round trip is proved.

fuzzTargets.name: lean-fetch-request
fuzzTargets.description: Lasm.Fetch request parsing as Node's host builds requests (path, query, cookies, Host)

fuzzTargets.name: lean-rpc
fuzzTargets.description: Lasm.RPC request and response decoding, and Lean's JSON round trip

fuzzTargets.name: wasi-cgi
fuzzTargets.description: the WASI C host's CGI request and response (src/wasi/lasm_fetch_wasi.c), with ASan and UBSan
